title: Protein language models flag high-risk SARS-CoV-2 variants before WHO designation
summary: An early warning system combines spike structure modelling with protein transformer language models to rank variants for immune escape and fitness. It flagged all 16 WHO-designated variants on average more than 1.5 months before designation, selecting under 0.3% of weekly novel variants, and flagged Omicron BA.1 on the day its sequence appeared. The metrics were also checked with pseudovirus neutralisation and binding assays. First posted version is 2021-12-27; a later version (2022-09) exists, and the claim is early detection, not prevention.
